page.overview:
What is Vaeternus?

Vaeternus is a realm in the Mortal Kombat video game series. It is the Homerealm of fighter Nitara, and the birthplace of the vampiric “Vaeternians” (also known as Moroi).

Vaeternus is a dark realm that is seemingly perpetually shrouded by clouds and plagued by lightning storms. The architecture of most of if not all buildings is [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gothic_architecture gothic] or perhaps [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gothic_Revival_architecture Gothic Revival] in appearance.

Vaeternus was a realm that was conquered long ago by Shao Kahn and was incorporated into Outworld, in the original timeline.

It was home to the vampires, and one of their kind, Nitara, sought a mysterious orb within Outworld that would permanently release her dimension from Shao Khan’s control. She was successful in her goal, later freeing her homeworld with the aid of the cyborg ninja Cyrax.
